entries.prompt: Electra and Poz look at one continuous purple trail on the white floor. The first part of the trail is softer and paler; the next part is fresher and slightly deeper purple. The ordering of motion is readable without arrows or labels.

entries.label: Near And Far
entries.story_text:
Some parts were close.

Some parts were far.
entries.lesson: Spacing helps tell the story of a path.
entries.geometry: One trace section has close spacing, another has wider spacing.
entries.background_concepts: Spacing, relative distance, path continuity.
entries.prompt: Show one purple path trace with some marks close together and some farther apart. Electra and Poz compare spacing by looking at the trail. Keep marks rounded and child-readable, with no grid, ruler, or diagram-like measurement symbols.

entries.label: The Water Remembers
entries.story_text:
Electra tapped the water.

Circles grew from the tap.
entries.lesson: Water can show where motion began.
entries.geometry: Concentric ripple rings mark the water source point.
entries.background_concepts: Water memory, source point, radial spread.
entries.prompt: Electra gently taps a shallow white tray or small patch of pale purple-blue water, while Poz watches nearby. Concentric purple-blue circles grow from the tap point. Keep the water simple and flat with clear rings and no extra scenery.

entries.label: The Sound Remembers
entries.story_text:
Poz clapped.

Electra heard it after.
entries.lesson: Some traces travel before they are noticed.
entries.geometry: Rings radiate from Poz's hands to Electra.
entries.background_concepts: Delayed trace, sound reach, propagation.
entries.prompt: Poz claps once while Electra listens a short distance away. Soft purple rings move outward from Poz’s hands toward Electra. The rings are a traveling motion trace, not musical notes or symbols. Keep the scene simple, white, and calm.

entries.label: The Shadow Walks
entries.story_text:
Poz walked past the light.

The shadow walked too.
entries.lesson: Motion can be shown in more than one way.
entries.geometry: Shadow positions show earlier and current body locations.
entries.background_concepts: Shadow trace, repeating visual marker.
entries.prompt: Poz walks past a simple white/purple light patch on the floor or wall. A soft purple shadow follows him, with one or two faint earlier shadow positions behind it. Electra watches. Keep the shadow readable as motion trace and avoid turning it into another character.

Poz followed the trail.

entries.label: The World Shows Us
entries.story_text:
Ribbon.

Water.

Sound.

Shadow.

They all showed motion.
entries.lesson: Nature gives clues.

entries.background_concepts: Cross-modality memory, combined cues.

entries.label: The World Remembered
entries.story_text:
It moved.

The world remembered.
entries.lesson: Motion can leave readable history.
entries.geometry: All traces remain visible after movement stops.
entries.background_concepts: Retention, evidence, world-memory.

Keep the red and blue balls nearby and visible. The scene should feel calm: something moved, and the world kept a visible record.

Make a trail.
Follow it.
Again.

entries.geometry: Use the geometry already introduced in the story at activity scale.

entries.prompt: Back-matter activity source image for Nature Remembers Motion. Keep all traces physical and visible; no arrows, no labels, no symbols, no abstract panels..
